mission: New-sources plan step D0 (owner approved the plan 2026-10-19 00:34Z; N7 no permission requests, honest UA, robots.txt, stop on 403/429), on top of S1 to S4 (all merged to staging by 2026-10-20): the shared new-shop collector kit and the Dorasuta collector package, minus the HTML list-page parser, which waits for real fixtures. Kit: CardPirateBot User-Agent with the contact read from SOURCE_COLLECTOR_CONTACT (never committed; placeholders refused), robots.txt gate that fails closed, 5 s spacing plus jitter, same-host redirects only, stop on 403/429 or a challenge page, per-run request cap, source_dispatch_budgets reserve/settle and indefinite pause on denial, RAW-first storage with its own dictionary-encoder admission for registered new-source parsers. Dorasuta: series/page planner (page 1 daily, full sweep in 6 days, 150 requests cap), writer for source products, groups and condition variants, observations only for raw:A rows of exact or manual products with exactly one approved current mapping, and a resolver pass after each run. Nothing is deployed: there is no Dockerfile, Railway service or schedule, and run.main refuses before any request without a contact, a registered parser and a series list. Staging only; no change to the yuyutei or snkrdunk collectors, their runtime inputs, rollouts, prices, identity guards, mappings, secrets or Railway.

impacts.reason: New package, not imported by any deployed service. Fetch etiquette, robots gate, budget, RAW write and run loop for new shops.
New package, not deployed (no Dockerfile or service). Planner, writer, resolver pass and a run entry point that refuses until D0b (parser) and D1 (contact variable, service) land.
Adds source_collector_kit and dorasuta_collector to the existing collector-tests matrix so their tests run on every PR. No other job, trigger or permission changes.
Plan §2.7 guard extended to both new packages: neither may be a Yuyu-Tei or SNKRDUNK collector runtime input.
